Defend the center and buy the plots around us!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 1 ([[D00M's Revenge]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Ducky''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had low health and an above average speed, but to compensate, it spawned in high numbers. Beyond wave 10, its health would increase over time. The '''Ducky''' could be spawned by the [[Eggroll]]. ==Appearance== The '''Ducky''' is a normal yellow duck with black eyes and an orange beak and feet. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[D00M's Revenge]] is listed instead. *Cheap towers like the [[Soldier]] and [[Golden Scout]] fare well against the '''Ducky'''. **Multiple [[Sniper]]s are recommended for their long range. In addition, the [[Sniper]] can also counter the [[Flying Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Flying Ducky]] that debuts later on in the game. *As many of these spawn, towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, like the [[Executioner]], can clear out hordes of this enemy. **Like the [[Sniper]], the [[Executioner]] can counter the [[Flying Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Flying Ducky]]. Do be aware that its hidden detection is too expensive to deal with [[Spy Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Spy Duckies]], a hidden enemy that debuts later on in the game. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDRDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} Duck Hunt 2022 icon.png|'''Ducky''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DuckySkincrateUpdateMay2023.png|'''Ducky''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} Ducks1.png|'''Ducky''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator- Duck Skins!|'''Ducky''' in a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Spring Trailer|'''Ducky''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} SoldierDuckyRender.jpg|'''Ducky''' on a render. DuckyUpdateClean.png|'''Ducky''' on a render. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyDuckyIconIG.png|'''Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *After the [[Duck Hunt Event]] ended, the '''Ducky''' could be seen in the lobby, floating on the small stream that surrounded the wooden [[Minigunner]] statue in some iterations of the lobby. *This enemy can be seen in some of the {{Color|Ducky|Ducky}} skins, like the [[Farm]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Mortar]]. ==Update History== *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **'''Ducky''' added. *'''28 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]] **'''Ducky''' removed. *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Ducky''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Ducky]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. ==Notes== {{D00MRevenge|Start|N/A|Ducky|Wave 1|[[Cool Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Cool Ducky]]|Wave 3}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Ducky}}
